## Linked Issues

Use GitHub keywords so issues auto-update on merge:

- `Fixes #123` / `Closes #123` / `Resolves #123` (auto-close on merge)
- `Refs #123` (link without closing)

Example:

```text
Fixes #123
Refs #130
```

## Related Commits

Paste one commit SHA or commit URL per line.

```text
abc1234
https://github.com/<org>/<repo>/commit/def5678
```

## Description

A clear and concise description of the PR.

Use this section for review hints, explanations or discussion points/todos.

- Summary of changes
- Reasoning
- Additional context

## Screenshots

Screenshots or a screen recording of the visual changes associated with this PR.

(Feel free to delete this section for non-visual changes.)

## Docs

Add any notes that help to document the feature/changes. Doesn't need to be your best writing, just a few words and/or code snippets.

## Ready?

Please confirm each item before requesting review.

- [ ] I have linked at least one issue using `Fixes #...` / `Refs #...`, or explicitly marked this PR as `N/A` for issue linkage.
- [ ] I have documented what is new (or marked `N/A`).
- [ ] I have added in-code documentation where needed (or marked `N/A`).
- [ ] I have written tests for new/changed behavior (or marked `N/A`).
- [ ] I have run the linter and addressed relevant issues.
- [ ] I have added screenshots/demo for UI changes (or marked `N/A`).
